title: NotReal
tagline: Tradeable AI-generated art NFTs that earn you passive income through AAVE
description:
It's an a.i. art market on ethereum, because I believe the intersection of generative AI and curation markets will be huge.

Some of the existing problems with NFT markets:
Huge oversupply
Lack of underlying value
Foggy price discovery
High fees and slow confirmation

notreal.ai solves these with:
- structured controlled supply of auctions
- royalties and AAVE interest staking for buyers
- Fast network agnostic bidding via Matic and Biconomy
how_its_made:
This was built using Solidity, Vue, Firebase, Matic, Biconomy and AAVE. It also uses graph protocol for indexing. It uses EIP712 Meta transactions for seamless network agnostic transactions.



Some features such as AAVE and graph protocol need to be re-integrated due to the complexity of integrating it onto Matic.
